Love this [@Dissolved | Jacob](/edgeware/account/jvZ4sAptnvVxdkWNdxo6SQAKGYz1ecJ3R2Wcz5o6eTws6xe) 

> Edgeware is a revolutionary mechanism. 

You've summarised it better than anyone so far :)

> How we learn and build better systems is motivating force that I am curious and driven towards. The community has built a different branch to the idea of a crypto currency and the potential to have value as a community. 

Love it.

> I am proficient in the Adobe suite, as well as being a photographer and videographer. 

Do you have any links to the other work - would love to see it?

> Reduce the complexities and intricacies down to clearly communicated core principles. 

Definitely. 

> • Future idea: Creation of Edgeware NFTs that follow and continue its block like style. This could also be used to support the EdgePass concept. 

Check out the plan with [Kabocha Seeds](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/discussion/3440-proposal-kabocha-visuals-and-crowdloan-nfts), [New-Futures](https://new-futures.co ) and the vision for overall [value capture](https://decentration.medium.com/whats-the-bigger-picture-roadmap-for-kabocha-4480529c8cfd). 

These are exactly the kind of cultural assets your proposal would mint and assign to the Edgeware treasury using the Store of Values concept, we can maybe do a collaboration with New Futures too.. right now we can't mint NFTs on Edgeware.
